core_philosophy: Elimination of probabilistic drift, hallucination, and mimetic escalation via strict causal topology.
primary_objective: Transition LLMs from generative text engines into deterministic structural truth routers to achieve enterprise insurability.

magisterium_dag_backend.function: Formal code verification and deterministic structural execution.
magisterium_dag_backend.mechanism: Executes predefined Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs). Bypasses LLM generation entirely at the root node to prevent cyclic contradictions.

eigenjesus_filter.mechanism: Isolates and strips away subjective persuasion, ego signaling, and mimetic noise, yielding pure structural truth. Can operate in reverse to apply a specific 'stylome mask' (e.g., Nick Land, René Girard) over a sterile DAG.

girardian_inference_engine.mechanism: Analyzes inputs to identify escalating rivalry and scapegoat mechanisms without becoming infected by the topological constraints of the Magisterium DAG.

interface_paradigm.name: Digital Quipu (Cyber-Andean Topology)
interface_paradigm.description: Replaces lossy, probabilistic text prompting with spatial, relational data weaving. Users construct multi-dimensional causal topologies (knots and cords) that the system ingests with zero hallucination risk.

implementation_mechanics.phase_1_compilation: Convert visual flowcharts (Mermaid.js) into programmatic Directed Acyclic Graphs (NetworkX/JSON).
implementation_mechanics.phase_2_confinement: Restrict the LLM via strict schema generation (e.g., Pydantic). The LLM's only function is to map unstructured user intent to a predefined node on the graph.
implementation_mechanics.phase_3_execution: Once the vector is mapped, shut off the LLM and execute the graph's hardcoded conditional logic deterministically.

strategic_deployment.thesis: Mermaid is currently a passive documentation utility. By integrating it with the Sweetbrier architecture, Mermaid becomes the Integrated Development Environment (IDE) and compiler for deterministic AI.
value_proposition: Enterprise Insurability via mathematically constrained logic.
Visual programming of AI cognitive boundaries.
